answer: That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that burns. The dawn counter is kept in jetty and pearl shows each threshold crossing. An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 7 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
